subject: POC planning: success criteria, owners & weekly cadence
messages:
From: Emma Carter <emma@brightscale.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + POC next steps

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to see Redwood's latency/cost tradeoffs and the KV cache approach. We are keen to run a short POC to validate two things: (1) end-to-end latency for our 1k concurrent session demo, and (2) inference cost per 1M tokens after caching.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with our proposed success criteria and baseline metrics. Proposed high-level timeline: kickoff next week, 3-week evaluation, final readout week of July 13.

Can we confirm owners on your side and a weekly check-in cadence? Also want to get a statement of work / SOW template to share with procurement.

Thanks,
Emma

Head of Data Products | BrightScale Inc
emma@brightscale.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Date: 2026-06-20T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Discovery recap + POC next steps

Hi Emma — great to meet you and thanks for the clear criteria.

Summary / proposed plan:
- Kickoff: Tuesday 2026-06-23 (30 min) to align scope and access.
- POC window: 3 weeks (2026-06-24 to 2026-07-15).
- Weekly check-ins: Mondays at 10am PT (15–30 min) for status, blockers, metrics review.
- Final readout: 2026-07-15 (45 min) with performance & cost deck.

Owners: Redwood (Sales/Coord): me (Karthik) — commercial + scheduling; Technical lead: Priyom Das (solutions eng) — environment & telemetry; Project operations: Laura Bennett (customer success) — onboarding, runbooks.

Success criteria (draft):
1) 95th percentile inference latency <= 400ms for our 1k concurrent session synthetic load.
2) Inference unit cost <= $X per 1M tokens after caching (baseline vs. optimized).
3) No PII leakage in logs; access and audit trail confirmed.

I'll drop a POC SOW draft and a list of telemetry endpoints we'll need. Priyom — can you confirm required credentials/access and the sandbox capacity we should provision? Laura — can you set up the calendar invites for kickoff and the Monday check-ins?

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: 2026-06-21T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Discovery recap + POC next steps

Hi all — quick technical checklist and notes from my side:

1) Sandbox/provisioning: we'll spin up a dedicated 2-GPU pool in us-west with the optimized quantized variant you requested. Please provide service account creds or an allowlisted IP for data transfer.
2) Telemetry: we'll instrument per-request latency, token counts, cache hit rate, and per-model kernel selection logs. Please confirm which endpoints in your app I should hit for synthetic load.
3) Datasets / prompts: share a representative sample (10–20 prompts + expected outputs). We'll run both synthetic concurrency and replay tests.
4) Security: we will enable customer-managed KMS for the POC; need the key ARN.

I'll prepare a short runbook (ops checklist) prior to kickoff and post it to the shared Drive link.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
